hooks.pre-edit: npx ruv-swarm hook pre-edit --file $FILE --auto-spawn-agents true --optimize-topology true
hooks.post-edit: npx ruv-swarm hook post-edit --file $FILE --train-on-success true --auto-format true
hooks.pre-search: npx ruv-swarm hook pre-search --query $QUERY --cache-results true --optimize-search true
hooks.session-end: npx ruv-swarm hook session-end --export-metrics true --generate-summary true --persist-memory true
hooks.pre-task: npx ruv-swarm hook pre-task --description $TASK --auto-spawn-agents true --optimize-resources true
hooks.post-task: npx ruv-swarm hook post-task --task-id $TASK_ID --analyze-performance true --train-patterns true
hooks.notification: npx ruv-swarm hook notification --message $MESSAGE --telemetry true --analyze-sentiment true
